EVIDENCE (2026-05-23): sprint of epic 81d7-9da2-676e-4948 just merged 3 story-to-session PRs that confirm and extend the symptom:

PR #292 (story a7c0-8e53 → session worktree-20260522-180209): llm-review status = SKIPPED (gated to base_ref == 'main')
PR #293 (story ab28-87ea → session worktree-20260522-180209): llm-review status = SKIPPED + Lint Python (ruff) FAILED with auto-merge race (actions/checkout couldn't fetch refs/remotes/pull/293/merge because PR had already been auto-merged)
PR #294 (story b2b0-40b9 → session worktree-20260522-180209): llm-review status = SKIPPED + Script Tests FAILED with orphan-process kill (job terminated mid-run by auto-merge)

EXTENDED FINDING beyond the original 576b symptom: branch protection on the session branch does not require Lint Python or Script Tests as a passing condition for merge. Auto-merge fires when the *required* subset (Ticket tests, ShellCheck, Hook Tests, Portability Smoke) is green, before slower checks finish. So even the *remaining* CI checks (after llm-review skip) do not all run to completion before squash-merge. This means story→session PRs merge with even less coverage than the SKILL.md documented gap implies.

The user has now flagged the missing llm-review on these PRs. As a compensating control for this sprint run, a local code review will be executed on each PR's diff. The systemic resolution remains the remediation epic referenced in the original ticket body.
